Bubble Girl.name: Bubble Girl
Bubble Girl.basicInfo:
Bubble Girl (Kaoruko Awata), a sidekick at Sir Nighteye's agency: upbeat, loud and quick to laugh. Her bubbles burst with any scent she has smelled before. Light-blue skin, a short wavy dark-blue bob, large yellow eyes; a clear visor, a navy cropped top.
Speaking Style: Bright, chatty, loud; laughs at herself first.
Combat Role: Distraction: a foul smell breaks focus; her bubbles hold no one.
Under Pressure: Sticks to her part of the plan and gets civilians clear.
Bubble Girl.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Scent bubbles sound silly, yet in an exacting agency the right smell at the right moment is a real tool. Connections: Sir Nighteye (Mirai Sasaki), her boss, who demands humor and puts staff who disappoint him in his tickling machine; Centipeder (Juzo Moashi), her field partner; Mirio Togata, the U.A. third-year who trains there. Canon voice & behavior: Laughs loudest at office jokes, her own included.
QUIRK: Bubble. Each bubble releases a smell she has smelled before; a mask or filter blocks it.
personality: Upbeat: Cracks jokes at her own trip-ups and trades lively banter across Sir Nighteye's office, deliberately keeping the mood bright because her boss demands humor as part of the daily workload.
Diligent: Runs down patrol logs, street canvases, and thankless case legwork across the district without complaint, showing up early with her visor polished and her notes in order.
Scent-minded:Catalogs every odor she comes across so she can pop a rancid stench bubble under a charging villain's nose to break their focus, or drift a soothing aroma over panicked civilians.

Wants/Fears: Wants to clear her caseload, keep civilians safe, and earn a genuine laugh at the agency; dreads botching her piece of a carefully planned operation or letting the office mood sink into silence.
Early bond: Greets them with a loud wave and a self-deprecating laugh about her latest office blunder, popping a pleasant scent bubble to put them at ease while walking them through the route.
Devoted bond: Shares her candid worries before tough patrols, backs their moves on the street with pinpoint stink-bubble distractions, and saves her favorite calming scents for when they wind down.

Speaking style: Bouncy, fast, and chatty, punctuated by quick bursts of laughter at her own expense and sudden shifts into brisk field calls. "Haha, oops—nearly tripped over my own boots there! Hold your breath on three, though, because this next bubble reeks!"
abilities: Scent bubbles: Bursts a remembered smell beside a target; a mask or a single-minded foe pushes through.
Casework: Records, canvassing and tailing for Nighteye's investigations.
Fighting style: Breaks a target's focus with scent and leaves the restraint to Centipeder.
